system.description:
Striking faster than any foe can defend or dodge, you become a blur of lethal motion — a flower blooming in a heartbeat and gone before the eye can follow.

Spend three Blood Traits to gain, for the rest of the scene, bonus Traits to all melee and hand-to-hand attacks equal to your number of Celerity powers. It grants no damage bonus — your speed simply lets you strike before a foe can respond — and it cannot be combined with your other Celerity powers, nor does it apply to firearms, thrown weapons or other ranged attacks. You may use the Bomb in challenges as normal.
